Particle Physics 2D

Enable com.bengine.particle-physics2d, add Effects / Particle Physics 2D Collision, and enable collision on the attached Particle System 2D.

The provider sweeps a circle (or a ray for zero radius) against Physics2D colliders. Configure layer mask and trigger inclusion here; configure bounce, damping, lifetime loss and Collision sub-emitters on the particle system.

Edit-mode preview queries authored colliders without advancing rigid bodies, then restores the previous physics world. Particles respond to colliders but do not apply rigid-body forces.
